Catering & Events

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 9 of 15).
Allowability of Food Costs
Brainstorming Notes
Food and catering costs may only be charged to a sponsored project when they directly support the approved scope of the award, are included in the project budget and justification, and are approved by the sponsor. These costs should not be used for general hospitality, routine meetings, weekly check-ins, or convenience. Catering may be appropriate for project-related activities such as all-day conferences, workshops, trainings, or participant events where providing food is necessary for the event to function effectively. Please Note: On-campus catering must be ordered through Sodexo Magic , Morgan’s required on-campus catering vendor.
Complete the content above before moving on.
On-Campus Catering: Sodexo Magic
Sodexo Magic Order Process
Morgan State University requires the use of Sodexo Magic for on-campus catering services. This section provides a step-by-step guide to obtaining quotes, completing the required approvals, and placing a compliant catering order for sponsored project activities.

Reserve A Space
Identify a room/space if your event cannot be accommodated within your office space and request its use through appropriate building staff. Be sure to confirm with your office admin team if use of that space is appropriate for your needs.
Create Sodexo Magic Catering Quote
Navigate to the MSU's Catering Services page and select " Order Online Here! " to review Sodexo's menu options and pricing. If you have not used the system before, create an account before proceeding. Standard Food Order: If your event requires only food service, create your order and save the shopping cart as a PDF to use as your catering quote. Additional Event Services: If you require event staffing, table linens, centerpieces, or other special accommodations, email Monica Davenport ( monica.davenport@sodexo.com) with a description of your needs and a screenshot of your food order to obtain a complete quote. Before finalizing your request, be prepare to provide your preferred: Event setup time Meal service start time Meal cleanup time
Enter Banner Requisition
Submit a Banner requisition and collect all required event supporting documentation, such as: Space reservation request Event flyer or agenda Anticipated attendee list Once the requisition has been entered, email your Sodexo quote and supporting documentation to the below admin teams. Ensure you enter the requisition number in your email heading. MSU Procurement: services.procurement@morgan.edu ORA Budget Officers: Lucy Manyara ( lucy.manyara@morgan.edu ) Shamon Shine-Lee (shamon.shine-lee@morgan.edu)
Contact MSU Events Office
Complete the MSU Events Event Initiation Form to retain MSU Events service, identify space requirements, provide funding, etc. This form will minimally request the following information: Department Name Primary Contact Purpose & description of event Expected # of attendees Catering/Service Request Requisition # Department Index Used as a backup funding source if a requisition isn't entered and provided to MSU Events. Must be provided in "Event Justification" for all events that require catering. Upon returning the completed form, MSU's Events will provide a Reservation/Event # . You may use this to complete your catering order in the Sodexo order portal. Please Note: If your event requires A/V support you will need to contact DIT directly to coordinate.
Complete Sodexo Magic Order
With the MSU Events Reservation # in hand you are able to complete your Sodexo catering order through their order portal. Please Note : To finalize the order process you need to provide the MSU Events team with your completed purchase order (PO) once generated by the MSU Procurement team.
